events.title: Play The Updated Steam Next Fest Demo!
events.summary: You can now play the new demo of Firefighters Code Red as part of Steam Next Fest!What can you expect?In Firefighters Code Red, the dev team draws on their experience from Firefighting Simulator – The Squad to send you to over 30 different locations across North America. Suit up and head exactly where everyone else is fleeing from: straight into the fire, through blazing buildings, thick smoke, and collapsing structures.
